work.title: Untitled (Dense Mixed Collage)
work.description: Densely layered collage combining concentric target rings, chess pieces, compact discs, and geometric color blocks across a white ground. Orange, yellow, black, and red elements compete for space alongside scattered circular motifs and linear elements.
work.composition: dense all-over horizontal layering on white ground
